versions.changelog: Generalize room booking for any Feishu tenant. Adds first-use company onboarding, calendar-based room ID import with no manual JSON editing, configurable tenant catalogs, safer runtime-state packaging, and updated public description.
Fix room RSVP verification by matching room_id, safely skip events without attendee-detail permission, and show waitlist start time correctly. Adds regression tests.
新增会议室 reflection 二次校验：扫描和预订后统一按 confirmed/pending/failed 做保守判断；resource pending 不再误判为已有会议室，resource declined 会重新进入补订；仅当前用户已 accept 才触发预订，当前用户是会议发起者时视为已 accept；同步更新候补验证状态和技能文档。
新增工区时间线管理；未指定楼栋时支持用户偏好→当前/下周工区兜底；同步增强楼层/房间号匹配与自动补订规则。注明为字节内部使用的会议室预订技能。
初始版本：支持会议室查询、日程创建+预订、个人偏好管理、自动扫描补订、候补轮询
